shared_elements: schematic human/anthropomorphic forms (a full statue figure vs. rows of stick-like crew figures)
justification: A depicts a single monumental frontal anthropomorphic figure with a massive head, brow, nose, and torso with nipples and arms; B depicts several profile boats with upturned prows carrying rows of tiny vertical crew strokes, scattered over a rock surface. The only faint correspondence is that both reduce the human form to schematic conventions, but the subjects, relationships and layout share nothing specific.
